[goal] Make the Pixel Arena backend match docs/CONFIG.md and docs/ECONOMY.md so the integration test passes, fixing root causes.

- `arena_server/config/loader.py`: env was applied *before* the JSON file, so the file overwrote live-ops overrides. Reordered to DEFAULTS < file < env; `_coerce` now casts against the default's type (int/float/bool) and raises `ValueError` naming the received value and expected type.
